description: On a phone, binary-as-text cannot be edited or saved. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The overlay ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". In its working-changes overview click ".diff-rethink-mobile-files .diff-tree-code-row[title='opaque.bin']". The panel with data-testid "binary-file-panel" is visible. There is no button named exactly "Edit". Click "View as text"; the ".diff-viewer-editor" becomes visible and there is still no button named exactly "Edit". Click the last ".editor.modified .view-lines" and insert_text "must-not-write". It must not contain that text. Press Control+s, then call "opaque.bin": it returns exactly "0002ff".
